dst_port_experiment.interpretation: A large positive delta indicates Dst Port provided leaky predictive signal (e.g., FTP is always on port 21). A near-zero delta suggests no significant leakage through this column.

metrics.tier2_label_source: In run_unseen_multi_attack_loop.py, the Tier 2 labels for escalated samples are produced by a TRAINED RandomForestClassifier (tier2_rf) fit on EMBER 2018 static PE features — NOT the CIC-IDS dataset ground-truth labels. The Tier 2 model serves as a proxy for deep verification. This introduces an impersonation risk: if the trained Tier 2 model is wrong on novel network flows (which it was not trained on), the pseudo-labels it generates may be noisy or incorrect. The CIC-IDS dataset ground-truth labels (column 'Label') are used ONLY in the evaluation function to compute reported accuracy — they are never fed back to Tier 1 during the adaptation loop. This is documented fully in docs/tier2_label_source.md.
